question: Sikh Gurudwara Act was passed in _______ giving control to Shiromani Gurudwara Prabandhak Committee as the main body.
solution:
the correct answer is __**1925**__.

• Sikh Gurudwara Act was passed in 1925 giving control to Shiromani Gurudwara Prabandhak Committee as the main body.
